notes.title: Patch 1 Update
notes.notes:
Major Bug / Crash Fixes
• Fixes crashes related to loading between environments
• Eating the exit burrito while teleporting no longer causes you to be stuck in a void forever
• If you eat the exit burrito while holding the camera while it is in the pocket of the backpack with the other hand, you no longer become stuck in a void forever
• Intro task no longer becomes stuck if player waves at GigBot while giving rating
• Fixes camera becoming unable to take pictures
• Fixes rare stability issues due to subtitles
• Bots no longer accept business credit cards and exit burritos, which caused crashes
• Waving no longer cancels BaristaBot's burger request in 'Back to Job'
• Feature Improvements
• TempBot now requests 1 to 4 star items in the Infinite StarScanner gig

Visual Fixes
• Soap bar displays appropriate highlights when half eaten
• Improved visual quality of VacationBot's 'Back to Job' costume
• Various Port-A-Shrub issues have been fixed
• Font visibility for some video games and the GigBoard is improved
• Camera hover particles no longer separate from camera when relocated by a Bot
• GigBot no longer transforms into VacationBot if the museum lever is pulled without a passport inserted
• The size of condiment icons have been slightly increased on the GigBoard for some infinite gigs
• Bots in 'Back to Job' move more natural when transitioning between gigs
• BanditBot hat now hides player avatar hair correctly
• Other glasses are no longer visible when looking through the front side of pancake glasses
• Replacement hat no longer disappears from BabyBot's head
• RiverBot glasses no longer move when level of detail increases
• Forest teleport reminder tablet no longer faces up, instead of facing towards player
• Flower highlight now appears correct on shrubbed crab shell when animating
• Fixes rendering on seaweeds
• Giglr Mix icons for volume and channel are now more clear and distinct

Gameplay Fixes
• StarScanner and TempBot now agree on star ratings for books
• Breakable items will now break upon impact when used with the slingshot
• RaftBot dialogue timing now implemented as intended in 'Back to Job' 
• Fixed volume of the StarScanner not decreasing when bots are talking
• Improved the flow of certain infinite gigs if requested items are already liquid or slices
• Fixes InfluencerBot phone is being removed from backpack after returning to museum
• FishMaster cartridge no longer unlocks in the main game from 'Back to Job'
• JobBot's business card no longer disappears from backpack
• Honeymooners now respond to waving when requesting chocolate in 'Back to Job'
• Berries and mushrooms no longer enlarge quickly after placing them on certain points
• OpsBot tube tray now retracts consistently in 'Back to Job'
• Certain fruits will no longer be incorrectly identified as "Eaten" by StarScanner
• OpsBot now gives different items for pancakes and waffles
• Bots now accept either a chonky choco bar or a chocolate bar when requesting chocolate
• Bots now able to drink out of both coconut halves
• GigBot expressions during promotions now working as intended
• Auto-orientation of dumb-bell, phone, and StarScanner have been improved
• All cups (not just mugs) now attach to drink floatie

Other
• GigBoard now plays a sound effect when GigBot gives player their first 5 stars
• Fixes error with voxel optimization during sandcastle cleanup
• Fixed various minor issues

Fixed some animation issues with Oculus Touch controllers

Eye patches now work on snowman
Subtitles typo fixes
Fixed issues with stacking multiple sandwiches together
Credits in options now correctly resets when loading a new save
Taken photo attached to camera now orients the correct direction when taken rather than re-orienting continuously, which made it appear like it was a double sided photo
Fixed multiple items not rendering an icon when dehydrated


Gameplay Fixes

Fixed randomization timing of retrieving volleyball from river
Fixed issue when placing a melting item in your backpack which had resulted in the item not storing in your backpack
Fixed targets not appearing after shooting a single target in an area, leaving area and returning to it
Fixed VacationBot VO sometimes playing incorrectly when interacting with resort scanner
Resolved an issue where completing a set of photos and leaving zone too quick causes memory to not be correctly received
Fixed IceBot sometimes not delivering dialog when pulling “Judge Me” lever
Fixed timing of SportsBot giving the memory in relation to their dialog
Fixed sports sometimes abruptly ending when player grabs the Beachball
‘Super Untextured Quad’ can now correctly be resumed after playing it the first time
Backpack no longer occasionally snaps to the wrong position for one frame when pulling it out
Fixed an issue with VacationBot not talking when you swiped your watch at the same time as getting a memory
Fixed a rare bug that would cause a hermit crabs’ shell to become permanently highlighted if it hovered up to your hand
Fixed a rare issue of VacationBot being in the wrong location during the end of the intro

Optimize ice sculpting decoration
Performance fix for taking off backpack with a dehydrated food item stored in it
Optimizations to save file size
A LOT of performance and memory optimization


Visual Fixes

Shrub flowers are now visually shown when you waffle a shrubbed item
Credits fixes
Fixed grab highlight flicker that sometime appeared on camera and shrubbed paintings
Visually improved underwater cutoff in river
Photos attached to camera no longer clip through backpack when camera is placed in it
Grammatical fixes in “Choose Wisely’ video game
Corrected image representation of ‘balloon’ in Vacaypedia
More typo fixes in Non-Work Station email than we would like to admit
Fixed bathroom mirror visual moving incorrectly when you changed the height of the table
Water splash VFX and SFX no longer incorrectly play when trying to grab anything inside of Fruit Punch container
Fixed numerous pieces of geometry not rendering correctly when taking a photo
Vanilla ice cream no longer looks like chocolate ice cream when printed from the printer

notes.title: See What We Said? Vacation Simulator Subtitles Update + Language Support!
notes.notes:
Do you see what I’m saying, Human? Now you do! We’re incredibly proud to share an important update for Vacation Simulator— SUBTITLES!! 💬 This includes subtitles, icon and visual accessibility updates + additional language support. More info on our blog!: https://www.owlchemylabs.com/vacation-simulator-subtitles-update-language-support

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34643199/7e524fc08957c9565b5537178a37e7dd58564b41.png

Patch Notes
New Features
Subtitles have been added, with language support for English, German, Spanish, French, Korean, Japanese, and Binary
Iconography has been added to various objects in the world to make their functions clearer

Feature Fixes
Improved controller support for Vive Cosmos
Added controller images for both Vive Cosmos and Oculus Rift S
Fixed hand animations not firing occasionally when controller’s power is cycled
Fixed Oculus Rift S physics steps to match display rate
Fixed rare issue with postcards sometimes not advancing

Gameplay Fixes
Fixed issues that could occur while listening to the “Local Local Radio” station
Fixed cake/party hats floating when lowering the entertainment center
Fixed timing issue with camera intro
Updated pancaker icon in food orders

Performance Fixes
Numerous performance improvements through the game

Other
Added feedback for eating a lot of berries by the berry bush in the hiking trail
Fixed various minor issues

notes.title: Patch 4 Update

notes.title: Patch 3 Update + Valve Index Support
notes.notes:
Index Support!

Vacation Simulator supports the Index controller
Peace Out or Rock On in your selfies! The hands have been updated to recognize each fingers movement
120 Hz support! If your PC is capable of running VR at 120 Hz Vacation Simulator fully supports the higher framerate!


Major Bug / Crash Fixes

Wild Bot no longer disappears. We have convinced them to stay at their station.
Fixed an issue where the hands stop colliding with the world
Fixed a crash when players took A LOT of photos


Gameplay Fixes

Fixed an issue where L’aqua can doesn’t store in backpack when placed over your shoulder
Fixed an issue where player can teleport across multiple zones / biomes when spamming the teleport button during loads
Fixed an issue that caused snowballs to stop spawning
Crane Castle sand puzzle now shows 5x5 grid
The mountain and forest order boards now collide with items
All pictures now have shadows in them
The joystick is no longer colliding with itself and is useable
Waffled Glasses now attach to glasses rack


Performance Fixes

Addressed various unhandled exceptions that caused performance issues


Visual Fixes

Shrubs that are part of other objects now change colors when the shrub dial changed
Fixed an issue where the credits were visible in the party before they started rolling
Fixed an issue where objects could get stuck “highlighted” when held near the backpack
D20 no longer endlessly spawns particles when placed in backpack on rolling a 20 or 1
Fixed a Windows MR issue where controller diagram was not visible during tutorial



Fixed various minor issues

notes.title: Vacation Simulator Patch 2 Released! (Accessibility & More)
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34643199/ce58a5904930d234cf433f10c19a709dad7b569d.png
Your vacation just got a little more accessible! Vacation Simulator Patch 2 is OUT NOW on Steam VR and Oculus. 

Enjoy exquisite amenities like Accessibility Enhancements, Bug Fixes, Performance Improvements, and more!— Read all about it in our blog post here. 

Full patch notes below:

Accessibility Updates

One Hand Mode
Seated/Comfort Improvements
Non-Audio Feedback Improvements


One Hand Mode

When only one controller is connected, One Hand Mode is enabled which makes the game 100% completable with one hand
Skiing, rafting, yoga can now be started by grabbing one ski pole, raft handle, and yoga weight respectively
Adjusted climbing wall fall speed when one handed
Fixed a few caps that were previously not removable without two hands
Books open automatically 
Slingshot and joystick float when released
Adjustments to knitting station interaction for one handed play
Roasting stick now tosses attached item when shaken


Seated/Comfort Improvements

Increased detection area for back-facing teleports (shouldn't have to rotate more than 90 degrees anymore)
Adjusted placement of many props in Small Playspace for easier reach when seated
Adjusted Bot handout positions for items to be more centered
Lowered Travel Museum counter so start lever is generally more reachable
Optimized Beach target to be visible when seated


Non-Audio Feedback Improvements

Added additional signs and icons for increased understandability
Sandcastle and Ice Sculpt Stations now give visual feedback
Bots with glasses now lift them when showing icons
Added icons to some bots when explaining tasks for better understandability
Added flower on Planting Station by default 
Shell Station music sheet now bounces in response to playing each note in the sequence


Major Bug/Crash Fixes

Fixed several issues causing broken saves and black screens at load time
Made deleting saves a bit more complicated so other very excited players don’t do it on accident 
Fixed crash after rehydrating a dehydrated item
Fixed crash during living things escaping waffles/dehydrated packs


Feature Changes

Harmonica now shows highlight on currently blown slot
Exported photos now remove all transparency
Airhorn can now be pressed with face
Added moon back to night sky during campfire story
Added sound and particle to dipping paintbrush in photo color
Instruments now blow bubbles when played underwater
Ukulele is now playable while not held
Ski Station game additionally responds to moving instead of just tilting poles
Added text to Fishing Order Board and A Human's Guide To: Fish book to help fisherhumans


Gameplay Fixes

Cooler no longer breaks when closing lid with a fish inside
Fixed Not-Tuna can sometimes opening with nothing in it
Fixed Resort phone playing wrong lines or delivering wrong items occasionally
Fixed yoga breaking if starting and stopping several times
Fixed lighting issue in Forest that persists until listening to part of campfire story
Fixed painting scaling when attached to certain frames
Fixed hermit crab overlapping with knitting preview and having weirdly colored shell once knit
Fixed player being able to teleport out of Summit without watching cutscene
Fixed radio breaking all other music when left turned on somewhere
Fixed some items not being retrieved when left outside playspace
Fixed some cases of items not respawning after removed from zone
Fixed waffle issues introduced (by Chris) in Patch 1
Fixed oversight where save file could be infinitely large thanks to photo waffle sandwich sandwiches


Performance Fixes

Improved performance when building/destroying complex sandcastles and ice sculptures
Improved performance when viewing credits
Fixed rafting getting out of sync


Visual Fixes

Fixed encyclopedia/waffles/dehydrated foods using low detail version of items
Fixed lighting on splash particles
Fixed lighting issue in Sunken Ship


Addressed various other minor bug fixes and issues

notes.title: Patch 1 Notes
notes.notes:
We just pushed Patch 1 live for Vacation Simulator! Here are the patch notes for this update:

Changes:

 There are now 5 Guest Passes (save games) available for players
 The fish now can breathe flames and/or bubbles, just like a human can!
 Minor VO additions and modifications to clarify specific cases of player confusion
 Spectator Headset View FOV now defaults to 60
 Spectator Headset View now mirrors screen fade
 Bathtub tap now turns off when leaving zone
 Added haptics to treasure chest lock
 SuntanBot now respects all cooling items
 VacationBot will now accept food order from Forest/Mountain/Overlook/Divesite/Hiking as well as Beach now
 Shampoo fluid now causes the player to spit bubbles that match bubbles being poured in the bath


Bug Fixes:

 Fixed a bug where VacationBot could end up in an incorrect position during the introduction
 Fixed an issue where audio could be duplicated when returning to the museum
 Trash cans can no longer destroy living things, and other fixes involving creature destruction
 Fixed an issue when attaching lenses to the handheld spectator camera
 Fixed an issue where WildBot wouldn’t hand the player a memory
 Fixed an issue where handheld spectator camera light was appearing in photos
 Fixed an issue with the Unicorn Horn hat clipping hair
 Fixed an issue where Skiing wouldn’t cancel when dropping on of the poles during the intro
 Fixed an issue where hats and mittens in small play spaces would return to the wrong position
 Fixed an issue where puzzle pieces could fall through the table
 Fixed some item icons and descriptions
 Fixed an issue where the tortilla chip would not cook
 Fixed an issue where the “Castle Blaster” game would not clean itself up properly and would curse future games and the bathroom mirror
 Updated beach order board to say PhotoBot2 to match mountain order board which says PhotoBot3
 Fixed an issue with saving paintings between sessions
 Fixed an issue where you could shred a guest pass and have it not respawn until restarting the game
 Fixed an issue where captain hat would appear on boat after you have taken it
 Fixed a few Vacay-pedia issues
 Additional minor bugfixes
